targeting_and_scaling.difficulty: Only five macro spell families have explicit RAID_MODE IDs in C++ (wind damage, gather strength, Wind Chill); most ability coefficients are in spell/DBC data not audited here. Heroic explicitly schedules Storm Shield.

phase_reset_credit.phase_model: No discrete phases; three platform-local bosses share repeating global energy/ultimate cycles.
phase_reset_credit.engage: Instance DATA_CONCLAVE_OF_WIND IN_PROGRESS zones Anshal, Nezir, and Rohash into combat and schedules global events.
phase_reset_credit.gathering: At below 1% local DamageTaken calls KillConclaveIfAllowed; if two other councillors are gathering it KillSelf()s all, otherwise lethal damage is clamped, events reset, and Gather Strength is cast.
phase_reset_credit.reset: Councilor evade disengages its frame, despawns summons, and despawns at evade. Instance failure cancels energy/warning/full-strength/Berserk events, resets Skywall DJIN states, despawns hurricane vehicles, and does not expose an explicit 60s full-health respawn timer.
phase_reset_credit.completion: Nezir JustDied casts 88835; instance DONE removes Al'Akir UNIT_FLAG_IMMUNE_TO_PC and calls ACTION_CONCLAVE_DEFEATED. Historical encounter row is spell 88835, but retail loot/credit behavior is not asserted.
phase_reset_credit.achievement: Spell 94119 is declared for Stay Chill but unused by the local file; Icy Veins requires seven Wind Chill stacks on everyone. Credit is blocked.
phase_reset_credit.cross_platform: Guides describe walking into wind launchers/air lifts between West-North-East; local bosses require victims to remain within each home radius. Exact launch vector, failure behavior, and client 4.4.2 movement are blocked.

conflicts: Energy threshold/cadence conflicts: Icy Veins says 90/+1s; Wowhead says 100 and about 1.5 minutes; local controller emits at 90s and repeats at 113.5s.
Every recurring local timer differs at least slightly from guide cadence; no exact range is promoted.
Guide normal/heroic numbers are not independently available for all four modes; local spell IDs do not prove coefficients.
Wowhead's 60-second synchronized-death/full-health respawn rule is not implemented as an explicit local timer.
Local source declares Stay Chill credit spell 94119 but never casts it; retail achievement/loot/credit is unresolved.
